svg.title: Изометрическое удержание в наклоне — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. One centered static full-body posture. Three-quarter side view. Athlete isometric bent-over HOLD without equipment: both feet flat hip-width on floor, knees softly bent, hips pushed back, torso inclined about 45 degrees from upright, long straight neutral back, head in line, arms crossed against chest. Clear stationary hip hinge, no arm motion, only one pose. No weights, bench, straps or text. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
